rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic devices for rent setting
rules.requirement: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.

notes: The document defines 'algorithmic device' as software using nonpublic competitor data, but the rule applies to the sale and use of such devices.
